parent_objective: audit the M2353 fail-closed reset-validation result before repair or rerun
blocked_by: M2353 reset validation failed 32 of 360 reset attempts
measured execution remains blocked until reset-validity is restored and audited
supersedes: direct repair after M2353 without failure audit
direct measured execution after failed reset validation
invalidates: the five M2350 candidate packs are reset-valid

public_gates: M2354 must audit M2353 failure distribution by pack scenario and failure type
M2354 must classify whether the next route is sampling repair patch repair schema repair branch synthesis or stop
M2354 must not rerun reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim reset-valid redesigned scenario pack

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits fail-closed reset-validation data and selects the next bounded repair or stop route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun reset rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if audit cannot classify the 32 reset failures
stop if audit tries to repair and rerun
stop if audit routes directly to measured execution
stop if audit claims reset-valid scenario pack
fallback_plan: route to seed-source sampling repair design if failures are seed/sampling specific
route to geometry/timing patch repair design if failures are caused by G-axis transforms
route to metadata/schema repair design if failures are validator or caveat-schema artifacts
stop for user review if no bounded repair is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2353 failed reset validation and requires result audit before repair

admission_evidence: M2353 contract, forbidden-key, metadata-caveat, and guardrail counts are clean
allowed_updates: M2354 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2354 audits task-quality reset failures and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2354; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Failure audit must preserve the failed reset result and not convert it into controller evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset-valid pack, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns the M2353 reset failure into classified task-quality evidence before repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether the current candidate packs need sampling repair, patch repair, schema repair, or branch stop before paper-route measured evaluation
must_synthesize_if: M2354 cannot classify the reset failures
M2354 proposes a third same-gate repair without new evidence
the reset-validation branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing the M2353 fail-closed result can localize the 32 reset failures and select a bounded non-ranking repair or stop route.
success_criteria: M2353 result_class and reset counts are summarized
failure distribution by pack scenario and error type is summarized
a bounded follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2354 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2354 ranks support policies or controller families
M2354 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2354 claims scenario redesign executed or reset-valid redesigned scenario pack
M2354 routes directly to controller comparison

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2353 reset-validation artifacts

decision_rule: M2354 passes if it preserves the failed reset result, classifies the failure, and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
